title: Effective resolution of CHIRPS v3.0 in West Africa: diagnostic code
description: Code accompanying the manuscript “What Does ‘5.5 km Daily’ Actually Mean? Resolution Claims of CHIRPS v3.0 in West Africa.” It computes the CHIRPS v3.0 station-density and station-blending R² diagnostics for West Africa and produces Figures 1 and 2.
